scope: Synthetic isolated SQLite path discovery; no real database, external repository, service, Unity or GameData access.

reproduction.historical_runner_usage: Copy the selected UTF-8 LF snapshot to its original runner repository path in an isolated checkout before reproducing that phase. The baseline query source is recoverable from baseline_revision and query_source.repository_path.
reproduction.fixture_selection: Case parameters and source identities are retained in every raw cohort. See docs/development/reference-graph-path-cost.md for commands and measurement boundaries.
reproduction.line_endings: UTF-8 LF; raw JSONL numeric fields and sample order preserved.

provenance_notes: Every performance sample from the initial screen, independent repeat, identical-baseline controls and final bounded diagnostic is published; unfavorable observations and outliers were not filtered.

Initial verification rows recorded both query source hashes but no runner hash. Its loaded runner is reconstructed by removing five metadata-only lines from the initial measurement runner. The reconstruction was not captured contemporaneously; fixture/query/verification behavior was unchanged.
Reused verification metadata is carried into measurement cohorts; these rows do not represent additional performance samples.

Historical initial/followup summaries retain their then-pending recommendation fields. The final manifest decision follows the bounded diagnostic and independent review; historical fields were not rewritten.
Preparatory untimed smoke files are private setup evidence, not adopted performance cohorts.
limits: Initial page CPU values are quantized and are not request wall latency.
The small-page initial CPU regressions, case 3 repeat wall regression and all unfavorable maximum-page samples remain in the raw cohorts.
Observed maxima fluctuate under identical-baseline controls. No absolute or cross-machine worst-case latency guarantee is claimed.

Earlier traced_retained_bytes records end-current with completed response and harness locals still owned. Only cleanup-diagnostic.jsonl measures current after explicit local release and GC; production does not force GC.
Peak reduction and repeated representative large-query CPU/wall gains are supported. Generic retained-memory or across-the-board latency improvement is not claimed.
